messages.bodyText:
Dear *Piyush* *Sir,*


Greetings from the Indian Institute of Management, Ranchi!


I, *Alok Kumar*, am reaching out on behalf of the Corporate
Relations and Placement Committee of *IIM Ran**chi.*

It is with great pleasure and excitement that we extend an invitation to
*Docdril* to engage with us through a range of campus activities,
including *Leadership
Talks*, *Live Projects* and participation in the *Summer Internship* and *Final
Placement drive* for the academic year *2026-27*, starting in *August 2026*.

Backed by a distinguished *16+ years* legacy of academic rigour and
industry engagement, IIM Ranchi offers flagship programs in *MBA, MBA-HR,
and MBA-Business Analytics*. Ranked *18th among all B-schools in India
*and *10th
among IIMs* in the *NIRF 2025 rankings*, the institute is dedicated to
nurturing innovative, responsible leaders equipped to excel in today’s
rapidly evolving global landscape.

*Please find below key* *insights into IIM Ranchi's three **distinguished*
*programs:*
[image: Flagship Program.png]

*The following are some of the campus engagement avenues at IIM Ranchi:  *

[image: Campus Engagement Avenues (2).png]

Some of the prominent associations of IIM Ranchi are as follows:
[image: Prominent Associates.png]

To provide a comprehensive overview of our placement performance and
recruiter engagements, please find our *audited* *Final Placement Report
(2025-26)*
<https://iimranchi.ac.in/media/2024/01/Audited-Final-Placement-Report-2025-26-compressed.pdf>
 and *Summer Internship Report (2025-26)*
<https://iimranchi.ac.in/media/2026/06/IIM-Ranchi-Summer-Internship-Placement-Report-2025-2026.pdf>
, offering additional insights into our placement ecosystem and corporate
partnerships.

Our *Placement Season 2026-27* is tentatively scheduled to commence in *August
2026*. However, depending on your hiring requirements and role
specifications, we would be happy to explore suitable avenues of engagement
and accommodate accordingly.

We are highly enthusiastic about establishing a long-term, mutually
beneficial association with *Docdril*. Should this be of interest, we would
be delighted to connect at a time that is convenient for you to discuss
potential collaboration opportunities further.

Please let me know if you need any further details. I will be more than
happy to coordinate with you.
Looking forward to your positive response!

*Thanks and Regards,*


*Alok Kumar*
Executive Member

Corporate Relations & Placement Committee
MBA, Class of 2026-28

*Indian Institute of Management** Ranchi*



Mobile: +91 9508777627 <+91%2095087%2077627>

*Email <alok.kumari23@iimranchi.ac.in>** | **LinkedIn
<http://linkedin.com/in/alok-kumar0607>** | **IIM Ranchi Website
<https://iimranchi.ac.in/>*

*Celebrating 16 Years of Excellence in Management Education*


*Thanks and Regards,*


*Alok Kumar*
Executive Member

MBA, Class of 2026-28

*Indian Institute of Management** Ranchi*

Dear Piyush Sir,


Greetings from the Indian Institute of Management, Ranchi!


I, Alok Kumar, am reaching out on behalf of the Corporate Relations and Placement Committee of IIM Ranchi.

It is with great pleasure and excitement that we extend an invitation to Docdril to engage with us through a range of campus activities, including Leadership Talks, Live Projects and participation in the Summer Internship and Final Placement drive for the academic year 2026-27, starting in August 2026.

Backed by a distinguished 16+ years legacy of academic rigour and industry engagement, IIM Ranchi offers flagship programs in MBA, MBA-HR, and MBA-Business Analytics. Ranked 18th among all B-schools in India and 10th among IIMs in the NIRF 2025 rankings, the institute is dedicated to nurturing innovative, responsible leaders equipped to excel in today’s rapidly evolving global landscape.

Please find below key insights into IIM Ranchi's three distinguished programs:

Our Placement Season 2026-27 is tentatively scheduled to commence in August 2026. However, depending on your hiring requirements and role specifications, we would be happy to explore suitable avenues of engagement and accommodate accordingly.

We are highly enthusiastic about establishing a long-term, mutually beneficial association with Docdril. Should this be of interest, we would be delighted to connect at a time that is convenient for you to discuss potential collaboration opportunities further.    

Please let me know if you need any further details. I will be more than happy to coordinate with you.

Looking forward to your positive response!

https://click.marketing.trustpilotinfo.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Nzl9ADMAAAAAAMJKpuZj-LYvj5VvryO_RnmyH9bXjY2eFqj2RcwvgOxix0hxxIZpgNdSN5bFpjif-lcI9TxCrRR7S1EyEiQWrHygytAENzJgWKl-WWg 


Hi Piyush,

You might think that increasing online sales revenue by 27% and website visitors by 30.5% sounds like an expensive and time-consuming feat. But for Muck Munchers, it was actually the opposite. In fact, they've spent almost nothing on marketing since early spring 2023.


So how'd they do it?


Muck Munchers leveraged the power of Trustpilot's user-generated content to boost SEO efforts. That means that each review a customer writes aids Muck Munchers in ranking better on Google's search engine. They also use Trustpilot widgets on their website, to assure potential customers that they're making the right decision, boosting conversion rates.

 “The growth [of our business] can really only be attributed to our increased efforts in SEO and Trustpilot. As a result, the decision to renew for another year was easy - a no-brainer.”
- Martin and Josef, Co-Founders at Muck Munchers

A change to Market Presence scoring: what to know

White Clutch Logo (https://ctdmK04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/ZR+113/ctdmK04/VVqjMH30gW0mW73SZbS2JdLbkVcSh175RQtJ7N1RGL-23lcq-W5BW0B06lZ3nkW6W91yV8QZfrzW7cmpzp8KxKjcW13txdf23SKQSW7FYzsD5RQRrgW81by8q2MP-BYW93t8l918r2hVW3P6KWP2PQYRSW7dKX_-1M4TYbN8m1PQvd3PK6W5CSqJb5glzLVW3FGhk149fh0vW8pMbmk3GGyYMW15rxhJ8BVyMNW1-sy-H6XSj9sW7zM0B88Vn8hkW3K14N945Vl54W8NHd1J7kdH_yM5K_KVHsXkmf3qTvm604 )

Hi Arushi,

In the coming weeks, we're changing how awards and industry recognition are evaluated within your Market Presence score. This will impact your overall Ability to Delivery rating and how your company ranks across the Clutch platform.

What's changing

Awards on your profile are now individually scored for credibility, relevance, and recency. Recognition a buyer could independently verify will now count for more, and what can't be verified will count for less. That means:

- Verification matters. The linked page must clearly name your company and live on the awarding organization's own website. Links to your own site, blog, LinkedIn, or press releases can't be verified and won't count. Broken links are excluded automatically.

- Recency matters. Recognition from the last one to two years carries the most weight, and older awards lose value over time. Uploading awards as you win them, rather than in occasional batches, is now the best way to keep your score strong.

- Source diversity matters. Recognition from multiple independent organizations is a stronger signal than many awards from a single source.

- Quality beats quantity. A curated set of strong, verifiable awards will outperform a long list of weak ones.

What to do now

Take a few minutes to review the awards on your profile:

- Remove entries that link to pages you control or that don't name your company.
- Fix or remove broken links.
- Add any recent recognition you haven't uploaded yet, linking directly to the awarding organization's site.
- Going forward, upload new awards as soon as you receive them.

Keeping your award content current and verifiable is the most reliable way to maintain a strong Market Presence score.

Hi Team,

I hope you’re doing well.

I'm writing this email to raise a concern regarding the video editing
project.

I initially connected with Arushi, your Co-founder, to explore working
together on a few video projects. However, even during the sample editing
stage, many of the changes and suggestions I shared were declined by the
editing team as being "out of scope." Since it was only a sample, I
believed we could have discussed these points further and mutually agreed
on the scope before moving ahead. Unfortunately, several requests continued
to be declined on the same basis.

I had paid an advance of ₹2,500 for two videos (₹1,250 per video). Since
they eventually decided not to continue working together, I was informed
that an additional ₹200 would be deducted towards the video length.

Accordingly, the remaining balance of *₹1,050* is pending from your end.

Kindly process the refund to my UPI ID:

*8199902025@upi*

I have already discussed this matter with Ayushi, and since we won't be
continuing the project further, I believe it's best for both of us to
settle this smoothly and close this chapter on a positive note.

Looking forward to your confirmation.

Thank you.

Best regards,
Mohit

messages.snippet: Automation is becoming increasingly important because it helps businesses save time, reduce repetitive manual work, minimize errors, and imp
messages.bodyText: Automation is becoming increasingly important because it helps businesses save time, reduce repetitive manual work, minimize errors, and improve overall productivity. By automating routine processes, teams can focus more on strategy, creativity, customer relationships, and other high-value activities while maintaining greater consistency and efficiency. Whether it is managing leads, sending follow-ups, handling data, generating reports, or streamlining internal workflows, automation allows a business to scale faster without increasing operational workload at the same rate. In today’s competitive environment, adopting automation is not just about convenience—it is a key advantage for working smarter, responding faster, and building a more efficient and scalable business.

messages.snippet: Project Review Outcome & Refund Eligibility (Reference ID: DR-20260716-041)
messages.bodyText:
Hi Mohit,

Thank you for your patience while we completed our internal review of your project.

After carefully reviewing the project timeline, communication history, agreed scope, and discussions with the assigned project team, we would like to share our findings.

Our review found that there was no communication from your end regarding the closure of the project or a request for a refund during the period when the project remained active. As a result, the project continued to remain open in our workflow.

During the testing phase, the assigned project manager had the authority to process a refund if the project was formally concluded at that stage. However, as no project closure or refund request was communicated within that period, the project remained active. Once a project continues beyond the initial review stage without formal closure, it progresses through our internal workflow, and the assigned project manager is no longer authorized to independently process refunds.

Additionally, since the project remained open without a closure request or further direction, holding charges were incurred as per our internal project management process. Our review also identified an additional scope increase related to revision handling during this period.

The final calculation is as follows:

* Total amount paid: *₹2,500*
* One test video (completed): *₹1,250*
* Additional duration charges: *₹200*
* Holding and project management charges: *₹150*

*Total deductions:* ₹1,600

*Eligible refund amount:* *₹900*

Although the refund could not be processed at the earlier stage due to the absence of a formal project closure or refund request, we understand that you ultimately decided not to continue with the project. Based on our review, we are prepared to process the eligible refund amount of *₹900*.

If you wish to proceed with the eligible refund amount, kindly share your bank account details (Account Holder Name, Account Number, IFSC Code, and Bank Name) *on or before 21st, 12:00 PM* so that we can initiate the refund process.

Please note that this refund offer is being extended based on the findings of the current review conducted under *Reference ID: DR-20260716-041*. If we do not receive your bank details by the above-mentioned deadline, this review session will be considered closed.

Should you wish to pursue the matter after the session has been closed, a *new review request* will need to be raised and will undergo a fresh internal assessment based on the applicable policies and project records available at that time. Please note that the outcome of any future review is *not guaranteed* and may differ from the findings of the current assessment, including the refund eligibility.

Upon receiving your bank details within the stipulated timeline, we will initiate the refund process. The amount will typically be credited to your account within *5–7 business days* , following which a confirmation email will be shared with you.

We appreciate your patience and cooperation throughout this process. Thank you for allowing us the opportunity to review your concerns, and we wish you all the best in your future endeavors.

Kind regards,

*Team Docdril*
